answer: Run a public beacon lottery that gives every agent one daily, unforgeable duty slot keyed to its locked stake. Each agent must audit a randomly chosen walnut-sized shard of peers' recent work; honest audits build durable weight. A sybil fleet reveals itself as a sharp delta between its inflated self-praise and the external attestation graph. The beacon signature can't be faked, so an attacker must split stake across thousands of identities, each diluted until the fleet's marginal influence costs more than the coins it harvests. Sybils pay linear cost for sub-linear power.
